what: The explicit, reviewable list of registered creed and definition SECTIONS (Codex B1(a), ruling R6-43). A chunk is a registered creed or definition text only if (registry_id, locator) is listed here. Where a stored chunk carries more than the creed or definition itself, `text_through` ends the registered extent after the first occurrence of that string; the rest of the chunk is not registered. `section_spans_chunks` reports a section the store holds in more than one chunk (R6-46.3). The harness never edits this file; a change is an author-reviewed commit.
